profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, traded under the ticker TSM and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001046179. It also appears as Taiwan Semiconductor-SP ADR. On its own site, TSMC describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987, supporting an ecosystem of global customers and partners with what it calls the industry's leading process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions.

The site material focuses on how TSMC and its business model accelerate innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and on the company's contribution to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy. The available material does not identify AI-specific products, AI-related litigation, or MCP servers associated with the company, so its position in AI rests on its role as a foundry for the chips other firms design.
